comparison.objective: Remove a hot-pot lid by opening it away from the operator; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1438 tests grasping, controlled pivoting on a rim, tipped transport, leveling, and placement; candidate tests recessed tool insertion and fine rotary force control.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1438 checks far-side-first opening order and staged removal, permanently rejecting unsafe opening; candidate checks de-energized adjustment, impact bounds, and lock retention. No spec versions exist.
comparison.reason: Safe lid pivoting does not overlap mechanical adjustment commissioning.
